description: `inspect` resolves PATH against cwd, then requires the normalized result to stay under the project root (gateway.py's `_relative_parts_within`) — a lexical `..` escape is refused before any file is opened, with a dedicated message distinct from a missing-file or symlink refusal, and the refusal itself is still audited to `.multiverse/inspect.log` (`outcome=refused: ...`) the same as a successful read.

.multiverse/inspect.log.regex: ^<TIMESTAMP>\tevent=inspect\tproject=sandbox\tpaths=\.\./\.\./etc/passwd\tbytes=0\treason=checking an escape\toutcome=refused: \.\./\.\./etc/passwd: resolves outside the project$
